entities.summary: Vasily Anisimov is a Soviet and Croatian billionaire businessman who made his fortune in Russia in a variety of industries, including aluminium, real estate and vodka production. He is also a former president of the Russian Judo Federation. In September 2022, he renounced his Russian citizenship.
